cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/bigcal.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo
rng = random.Random(2)
K = 256
true = [rng.randint(-10**6,10**6) for _ in range(K)]
meas = []
for a in range(1, K):
    b = rng.randrange(a)
    d = true[b]-true[a]
    meas.append([b, a, d - rng.randint(0,500), d + rng.randint(0,500)])
for _ in range(4096-K+1):
    a = rng.randrange(K); b = rng.randrange(K)
    d = true[b]-true[a]
    meas.append([a, b, d - rng.randint(0,500), d + rng.randint(0,500)])
prof = {'groups':K,'jitter_ps':[rng.randint(0,20) for _ in range(K)],'measurements':meas}
t0=time.time(); cal = para.calibrate(prof); print('calibrate', time.time()-t0, cal['status'])
# chain depth test: a path profile 0-1,1-2,...,K-1 with tight ranges forces deep chains
meas2 = [[i, i+1, 0, 100] for i in range(K-1)]
prof2 = {'groups':K,'jitter_ps':[1]*K,'measurements':meas2}
t0=time.time(); cal2 = para.calibrate(prof2); print('path calibrate', time.time()-t0, cal2['status'])
print('depth check', cal2['upper_ps'][0][K-1])
t0=time.time(); ok = algo._check_cal_artifact(cal2, prof2); print('path artifact check', time.time()-t0, ok)
t0=time.time(); ok = algo._check_cal_artifact(cal, prof); print('artifact check', time.time()-t0, ok)
EOF
